meta.name: Raymond Zheng
meta.description: Computer science student at the University of Waterloo. I build deep learning frameworks from scratch, real-time physics engines, and systems that hold up under thirty thousand players.

beacons.title: Raymond Zheng
beacons.subtitle: Computer Science · University of Waterloo
beacons.body:
I build things from the bottom up — a deep learning framework with its own autograd and GPU kernels, a physics engine with its own collision solver, a Minecraft world that thirty thousand people played.

Every light here is somewhere I've been. Pick one.

beacons.title: Work
beacons.subtitle: Where I've shipped
beacons.body: Ministry servers, an AI video startup, a campus committee, a coding school I founded, and a restaurant floor on a Friday night. Different rooms, same job: keep the thing running and leave it better.

beacons.title: Viewmax
beacons.subtitle: AI video generation
beacons.body: Working at Viewmax, an AI video generation company.

beacons.title: Government of Ontario
beacons.subtitle: Systems Support Officer · Toronto · ongoing
beacons.body:
Technical support for ministry staff — diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network issues across the floor.

Diagnosed and repaired enterprise server backup systems, improving the workflow of LTO tape-based backups.

beacons.title: Waterloo CS Committee
beacons.subtitle: Event Coordinator · Waterloo · 2026
beacons.body:
Event coordinator for the **Waterloo Computer Science Committee**. Administered a recruitment event with an industry partner (ZIP), managing budgeting and attendee flow.

Supported planning and execution of multiple events, including membership operations — registrations, payments, and record tracking.

beacons.title: ByteQuest Academy
beacons.subtitle: Founder · Mississauga · 2024
beacons.body:
Founded a ten-week coding program, managing curriculum design and instruction for fifteen students and volunteers.

Designed and delivered introductory Scratch and Python courses to improve youth access to STEM education, built around computational thinking and projects the students actually wanted to finish.

beacons.title: China China Palace
beacons.subtitle: Storefront Manager · Mississauga · 2024
beacons.body:
Supervised and coordinated team members through peak hours to keep service quality up when the room was full.

Ran front-of-house operations and daily closing procedures, handling customer issues and conflict resolution.

beacons.title: Projects
beacons.subtitle: Built from scratch
beacons.body: The through-line is *from scratch*: an autograd engine, a collision solver, a gameplay system with thirty thousand players in it. I'd rather understand the layer below than call into it.

beacons.title: NimbleML
beacons.subtitle: A deep learning framework · ongoing
beacons.body:
A lightweight deep learning framework written from scratch — over forty neural network modules, automatic differentiation, GPU acceleration, and transformer architectures.

On top of it, a high-performance GPT with BPE tokenization, tuned through fused kernels, flash attention, and mixed CPU/GPU execution.

beacons.title: Kinematica
beacons.subtitle: Real-time 3D physics engine · 2025
beacons.body:
A real-time 3D physics engine supporting soft-body and rigid-body interaction, with GJK-based collision detection for arbitrary meshes and custom solvers.

It ships with a tool for creating and configuring physics bodies through a material loading system, so a developer can prototype complex mechanics without touching the solver.

beacons.title: Post-It
beacons.subtitle: AR lens for Snapchat Spectacles · 2025
beacons.body:
An augmented reality lens built with Snap3D, driven entirely by hand gestures on Snapchat Spectacles.

Top 32 overall out of more than a thousand participants at **Hack the North 2025**.

beacons.title: MHDungeon
beacons.subtitle: A Minecraft world, 30,000 players · 2025
beacons.body:
A large-scale Minecraft server with custom gameplay systems written in Skript against the Bukkit API — dungeon generation, enemy scaling, parties, path-finding, bosses, and reward pipelines.

Scaled the infrastructure past **30,000 unique players**, resolving production issues and shipping new content live. I also ran the marketing, community outreach, and monetization, which cleared **$8,000** in profit.

beacons.title: About
beacons.subtitle: The short version
beacons.body:
I'm a computer science student at the University of Waterloo, in the co-op program. Most of what I know came from rebuilding a thing I'd used until I understood why it worked.

Right now that's machine learning systems: kernels, autograd, attention — the parts underneath the framework.

beacons.title: Education
beacons.body:
**University of Waterloo** — Bachelor of Computer Science (BCS), Co-operative Program. Sep 2025 – Jun 2030, Waterloo, ON.

**Google** — Data Analytics Professional Certificate. Jan 2024 – Jun 2024.

beacons.title: Skills
beacons.subtitle: What I reach for
beacons.body:
**Languages** — Python, C++, C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Racket, Skript.

**Machine learning** — PyTorch, TensorFlow, NumPy, CuPy, OpenCV, autograd, transformer architectures.

**Data** — Pandas, Matplotlib, SQL, MongoDB, data processing, augmentation, dataset analysis.

**Also** — React Native, Flask, Expo, .NET, raylib, OpenMP, GPU programming, computational geometry, real-time systems.

beacons.title: Contact
beacons.subtitle: Say hello
beacons.body: I'm looking for co-op terms in machine learning, systems, and graphics. The fastest way to reach me is email.
